entities.name: Render the PBK roadmap as an interactive skill tree
entities.summary: Project one deterministic dependency model as a clickable graph, semantic-zoom Mosaic, and equivalent ordered navigation without changing portfolio truth.

acceptance: Dependency depth and arrows derive only from authored requires relations
Graph and Mosaic consume one equal identity set
Project and containment hierarchy remain distinct from prerequisites
Selection and semantic zoom remain XState-owned and read-only
Every visual node and dependency has an ordered keyboard-operable path
Phone Playwright and Axe journeys pass without claiming public deployment

relations.summary: The skill tree renders the accepted strict portfolio model and saved view projections.
The explorer gains dependency-path navigation and semantic zoom over one immutable roadmap model.
